parameters.name: CredName
parameters.description:
- 01: Personal ID cards
  - **0101**: ID card
  - **0102**: Bank card
  - **0104**: Teacher qualification certificate
  - **0107**: Student ID card
- 02: Business scenario
  - **0201**: Storefront photo
  - **0202**: Counter photo
  - **0203**: Scene photo
- 03: Corporate qualifications
  - **0301**: Business license

parameters.name: CredType
parameters.description:
Credential type:

- 01: Personal ID cards
- 02: Business scenario
- 03: Corporate qualifications

parameters.name: IdentifyNum
parameters.description:
ID number:

Note
Only supports the ID numbers of second-generation resident IDs and Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan residence permits.

- When paramType is normal: enter the plaintext ID number.

- When paramType is md5: first 6 digits of the ID number (plaintext) + date of birth (ciphertext) + last 4 digits of the ID number (plaintext).

parameters.name: ImageContext
parameters.description: Base64 encoded image, choose one from `imageUrl`, `imageFile`, or `imageContext`.

parameters.name: ImageUrl
parameters.description: Image URL, choose one from `imageUrl`, `imageFile`, or `imageContext`.

parameters.name: IsCheck
parameters.description:
Whether to enable authoritative authentication

- ****0****: No
- **1**: Yes

parameters.name: IsOCR
parameters.description:
Whether to enable OCR recognition.

- **0**: No
- **1**: Yes

> IsOCR can be set to 1 only when **CredType** is 01.

parameters.name: MerchantDetail
parameters.description:
Merchant details:


> This field is required when PromptModel is set to DEFAULT.

parameters.name: MerchantId
parameters.description:
Merchant ID. 

> This field is required when ****CredName**** is set to **02**.

parameters.name: ProductCode
parameters.description:
Invocation mode:

- **ANTI_FAKE_CHECK**: Image anti-forgery check

- **ANTI_FAKE_VL**: Image anti-forgery check and semantic understanding

- **IMAGE_VL_COG**: Image semantic understanding

Default value: ANTI_FAKE_CHECK

> When **CredType** is set to 02, **ProductCode** can only be ANTI_FAKE_VL or IMAGE_VL_COG.

parameters.name: Prompt
parameters.description:
Customer-defined prompt content for image semantic understanding.


> This field is required when PromptModel is set to CUSTOM.

parameters.name: PromptModel
parameters.description:
Prompt acquisition method for image semantic understanding:

- **DEFAULT**: System default

- **CUSTOM**: Customer-defined

> When **ProductCode** is set to **ANTI_FAKE_VL** or **IMAGE_VL_COG**, this parameter must be provided.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudauth credential-verify --cred-type 01 --cred-name 0104 --image-url http://marry.momocdn.com/avatar/3B/B6/3BB6527E-7467-926E-1048-B43614F20CC420230803_L.jpg --image-context base64 --is-ocr 1 --is-check 0 --user-name '张0' --identify-num 429001000000008211 --cert-num 460100000 --merchant-id '无。' --product-code ANTI_FAKE_CHECK --prompt-model DEFAULT --prompt '无' --merchant-detail Value=关键字 Key=keyword --api-version 2019-03-07 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudauth CredentialVerify --region cn-hangzhou --MerchantDetail '[{"Value":"关键字","Key":"keyword"}]' --UserName '张0' --ProductCode ANTI_FAKE_CHECK --IdentifyNum 429001000000008211 --ImageUrl 'http://marry.momocdn.com/avatar/3B/B6/3BB6527E-7467-926E-1048-B43614F20CC420230803_L.jpg' --MerchantId '无。' --CredName 0104 --IsOCR 1 --PromptModel DEFAULT --CertNum 460100000 --Prompt '无' --IsCheck 0 --CredType 01 --ImageContext base64
